about: Chapter one's hidden map. The player only sees the room they're in and its exits. threat = the fight in the room (elites on 5/15/25, bosses on 10/20/30). goal = one of the chapter's three hidden goals, found by looking. requires 'goals' = sealed until all three are found. Keep room text to about two sentences.

rooms.name: The body dock
rooms.text: Bodies hang in racks under a tarp, tagged at the ankle and swaying with the sea. One of them is looking out through your eyes.

exits.hint: voices, and the creak of plastic

rooms.name: Bleached deck
rooms.text: Crate plates lashed edge to edge, sun-white and sticky with salt. Someone has scratched tally marks into every one.

rooms.name: Bottle field
rooms.text: Ten thousand bottles netted into a floor that shifts under every step. Some still have messages in them.

look.text: One note, the ink run: 'If you find this I am already sold.'

rooms.name: Rope walkway
rooms.text: A walkway of drums and rope over open water. The ropes are newer than anything else here.

rooms.name: Tarp shacks
rooms.text: Shacks of blue tarp and bottle walls, doors tied shut from the outside. A pot is still warm on a stove.

look.text: A child's drawing pinned to a door: a man lying down, and a little light at the back of his neck.

rooms.name: Grey Lane stall
rooms.text: A lantern-lit stall selling parts from a cool box, no questions asked. The seller doesn't look up when you arrive.

rooms.name: Pump-fleet hull
rooms.text: The upturned hull of a fishing boat, its belly painted with a woman's face. Pumps beat inside it like a slow heart.

rooms.name: The bilge
rooms.text: Knee-deep runoff under the raft, glowing faintly green. Something has been dragged through it recently.

rooms.name: Pump room
rooms.text: Hand pumps in rows, each worked by someone with a pump of their own in their chest. They keep time without looking at each other.

rooms.name: Cartel weigh-station
rooms.text: A crane scale hung over the water with hooks on the end. Everything that comes through here is weighed, including people.

rooms.name: Floating lanes
rooms.text: Canals between rafts, crowded with boats made of fridges and doors. Everyone moves aside for you, then stares.

exits.hint: humming, and the smell of ozone

rooms.name: Surgery barge
rooms.text: A white barge, scrubbed clean, with a row of steel slabs under bright lamps. It is the only quiet place on the water.

look.text: One slab has restraints, and an outline in dried fluid that fits you exactly.

rooms.name: Cable garden
rooms.text: Stolen power lines strung overhead like vines, sparking where they touch the water. Lights burn here day and night.

rooms.name: Net lofts
rooms.text: Nets hung in layers like curtains, heavy with plastic and the odd bone. Floats knock together in the wind.

exits.hint: steps, and a crowd going quiet

rooms.name: Generator raft
rooms.text: A ship's engine bolted to a raft, feeding half the archipelago. The people tending it are deaf, or have stopped listening.

rooms.name: Throne steps
rooms.text: Steps built of welded junk, climbing to a chair made of other people's parts. Offerings rot at the bottom.

rooms.name: The patchwork throne
rooms.text: A throne of limbs and casings, and something sitting in it that wears a crown of grafts. It has been expecting a visitor.

rooms.name: Drowned port
rooms.text: A container port that sank to its knees, cranes standing up out of the sea. The containers have been turned into streets.

rooms.name: Container streets
rooms.text: Rusting boxes stacked into alleys, each painted with a family's name. Most of the names are crossed out.

exits.label: Into a container
exits.hint: dark, and a smell of cold

rooms.name: Cold hold
rooms.text: A refrigerated container still running, its shelves lined with sealed bags. Each bag is labelled with a weight and a price.

look.text: A bag with your old face printed on the label. It is empty, and the price has been paid.

rooms.name: Crane yard
rooms.text: Cranes swinging loads over the water with nobody in the cabs. The hooks know where to go.

rooms.name: Cargo yard
rooms.text: Pallets wrapped in plastic, stacked three storeys high and stamped with inspection seals. The seals are newer than the cargo.

rooms.name: IOA gantry
rooms.text: A steel walkway over the port with an authority flag snapping at one end. Below, everyone is queuing to be counted.

rooms.name: Manifest archive
rooms.text: An office stacked with paper manifests, because paper can't be wiped remotely. A fan turns the pages back and forth.

look.text: A manifest line, stamped and signed: 'Unit 4471. Donor deceased. Chip intact. Do not wake.'

rooms.name: IOA checkpoint
rooms.text: A gate of shipping containers with a scanner arch and an officer behind glass. The arch beeps at you before you reach it.

rooms.name: Slag road
rooms.text: A causeway of furnace slag, still warm underfoot, leading into smoke. Barefoot workers walk it without flinching.

rooms.name: Canopy stall
rooms.text: A trader under a scrap canopy, selling parts still warm from somebody. She asks no questions and expects none.

rooms.name: Smelting barge
rooms.text: Plastic melted down in vats and poured into new decking for the rafts. The air tastes of it for days after.

rooms.name: Volkov foundry
rooms.text: A foundry where operator limbs are fitted to whoever can pay, or whoever is owed. The fitting chairs face the sea.

rooms.name: Plastic reef
rooms.text: A reef grown from drowned plastic, coral-coloured and sharp. Fish nest in old shoes.

rooms.name: Hymn walk
rooms.text: A path lined with pumps set into posts, each one beating at the same slow pace. Someone ahead is singing to them.

rooms.name: The Mother's chapel
rooms.text: A chapel built inside a whale's ribcage, with a woman at the centre whose heart is a pump the size of a drum. Every pump in the fleet beats in time with hers.

look.text: The Mother turns her pump toward you and says, very gently, 'There you are. We wondered which one you'd wear.'

rooms.name: Clinic pontoon
rooms.text: A pontoon of clean white decking with a queue of people waiting in silence. Nobody in the queue has any eyes.

rooms.name: CBN theatre
rooms.text: An operating theatre with a gallery of seats, all filled. They applaud when the surgeon looks up.

rooms.name: The drift
rooms.text: The rafts thin out into loose debris, roped together by nobody. The water here is very deep and very still.

rooms.name: The wake
rooms.text: A long scar across the water where something huge went down. The debris all points the same way.

rooms.name: The drowned spire
rooms.text: A tower standing under the sea with its top just breaking the surface, lit from inside. Whatever is down there has been listening for you.
